code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and respiratory acidosis, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, elevated CRP and ferritin, and a significantly increased INR. These findings suggest severe infection or inflammation (possibly sepsis), impaired gas exchange (likely respiratory failure), and coagulopathy. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are warranted.
